completedWork: RS-14: rs14-two-process-reserve.test.js starts two server processes (RS_DB_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS=5000) on one seeded SQLite file, one customer on each, both with an approved A+B plan, sends both reserves in the same tick; three rounds on new databases alternating the process: statuses [201,409], loser OUT_OF_STOCK with supplierCodes containing A, one active reservation row, reserved <= on_hand for every supplier, A reserved 1/1, loser plan non_executable, no 'database is locked'/SQLITE_BUSY in either process log. rs14-db-busy.test.js starts a server with RS_DB_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS=0 first, signs in and approves a plan, then a separate lock-holder process takes BEGIN IMMEDIATE: reserve is 503 DB_BUSY, Retry-After 1, request id equals the header, no SQL text, no reservation or idempotency row, and the same key gives 201 after the release; a control test shows reserve works without the lock. Helpers: server-proc.js gained jsonBody in request(), seed:true (runs scripts/seed.js with the shared test password), publicUrlOnLocalhost:true (free port, RS_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:<port>, retried on a clash), freePort, seedDatabaseFile, upcomingDemoDate (next Amman day, so a real-clock server always has future ready times); new lock-holder.js, lock-proc.js (holdWriteLock), plan-flow.js, contract-shape.js. Contracts: contracts.test.js has a route table of 44 scenarios (every one of the 43 fixture files plus GET /api/health inline) over three seeded in-process worlds; it checks status, JSON content type, X-Request-Id, requestId (top level on success, inside error on failure, equal to the header), error code/message, no stack/SQL text, and key-set and type equality with the fixture response (null matches anything, arrays by first element, Trace.inputs/candidates free-form, status-count maps by value type); a test fails for any registered route without a scenario; self-tests prove the comparer reports missing, extra and retyped keys. Routes not registered yet are SKIPPED with the reason (10 scenarios). Browser: test/browser/helpers/{harness,db,signup,screenshot}.js; journey-infeasible.test.js signs up a fresh customer through the UI per viewport, creates the request, confirms details with a $50 budget, and asserts the infeasible notice, blocking OVER_BUDGET, candidate codes, the 'Raise budget to $84.00 -> A+B' relaxation, no approve/reserve/execute/PayPal buttons, focus on the h1 after the route change, no horizontal scroll, no console errors/CSP violations/failed requests, a screenshot test/browser/out/journey-infeasible-{360,1280}.png, and a read-only database check (planning run infeasible, zero rows in reservations, reservation_items, supplier_orders, payment_operations, provider_calls, fake_paypal_calls, plan_versions, plan_approvals, no stock held).
